title: SlimFile Atlas Is Now on the App Store
subtitle: Compress your videos right on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, there's no account, and it's free to download.
imageAlt: SlimFile Atlas on iPhone, showing the home screen and 1.2 GB saved
homeLine: SlimFile Atlas is now on the App Store. Compress videos on your iPhone, free.
homeLineShort: SlimFile Atlas is on the App Store

highlights.title: Free up space on your iPhone
highlights.note: Videos are the biggest thing on most phones. Atlas makes them much smaller, so you can keep more of them and send them more easily on WhatsApp, email or anywhere else.

highlights.title: Nothing is uploaded
highlights.note: Atlas compresses your videos on the iPhone itself, using its built-in video hardware. Your videos never leave your phone. There's no account, no ads and no tracking.

highlights.title: Smart, simple compression
highlights.note: Atlas reads each video and picks a sensible size for it, and shows the expected result before you start. Choose Smaller for the tiniest files, or Compatible for videos that play almost anywhere.

highlights.title: Built for batches
highlights.note: Pick one video or a whole batch and compress them in one go. Your originals are never changed. Save the smaller copies to Photos or share them straight away.

title: You Can Now Sign PDFs on SlimFile
subtitle: Draw, type or upload your signature, add the date and your initials, and download the signed PDF. It all happens in your browser, so your document is never uploaded.
imageAlt: A document with a handwritten signature on the signature line

highlights.title: Sign your way
highlights.note: Draw your signature with a mouse or finger, type it in a handwriting style, or upload a photo of it on paper. The background is removed for you.

highlights.title: Put it exactly where it belongs
highlights.note: Add your signature, initials, the date or any text on any page. Move and resize everything until it sits right, then download the signed PDF.

highlights.title: Your document stays with you
highlights.note: Signing happens entirely in your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded to our servers, and nothing is stored.

highlights.title: Big file? Compress it first
highlights.note: If a PDF is 6 MB or larger, SlimFile offers to compress it first, so signing stays fast. Then sign the smaller file.

title: Introducing SlimFile Atlas: Offline Video Compression for Media Houses and Businesses
subtitle: SlimFile Atlas compresses large video files without an internet connection, so newsrooms, production teams and businesses can shrink their footage on their own machines and keep it private.

highlights.title: Works offline
highlights.note: Atlas compresses video on your own machines, with no upload and no internet connection needed. That makes it practical for large footage, and for teams on slow or expensive connections.

highlights.title: Built for media houses
highlights.note: Newsrooms, TV and radio stations, and production teams can shrink recordings for editing, archiving and sharing.

highlights.title: Your footage stays private
highlights.note: Video never leaves your organisation, which matters for unreleased content and sensitive recordings.

subtitle: Students at 13 universities in Ghana, Mauritius and the United States now represent SlimFile on their campuses, helping classmates work faster with their files.

highlights.note: Ambassadors show classmates how to get assignments under portal size limits, convert and merge files, scan documents with a phone, and write in SlimDocx.

highlights.title: A path to grow
highlights.note: Ambassadors run campus campaigns, earn recognition and move up through program levels, while gaining real experience with a Ghanaian technology company.

imageCaption: Christabel Maame Yaa Dekyem, SlimFile ambassador at the African Leadership College of Higher Education, Mauritius.

title: Meet SlimDocx: A Full Word-Style Editor, Free on SlimFile
subtitle: Write and edit documents with pages, tables and track changes, open Word files, and download as Word or PDF, all in your browser. Powered by ONLYOFFICE.

highlights.title: Everything you expect from Word
highlights.note: Pages, headings, tables, images, comments and track changes, in a familiar toolbar, with nothing to install.

highlights.title: Works with your Word files
highlights.note: Import a .docx file, edit it, and download it again as Word or PDF when you are done.

highlights.title: Saves automatically
highlights.note: Documents are saved to your SlimFile account, so you can pick up where you left off on any device.
